name: Testimonials
description: Customer quotes in six layouts: an XL single centered quote, a long-form quote flow, a centered text-only quote slider, a 3-column card grid with stars, an image+quote slider, and a featured dark treatment with portrait.
when_to_use: Narrative social proof from named customers. Use Credibility (reviews) for star-rated review volumes with aggregate scores instead of individual stories.
capabilities: single hero quote layouts (quote-xl, quote-flow with dedicated long_quote field)
centered text-only quote slider (slider-text) paged through items with progress dots
card grid with star decoration and avatars
slider pairing a portrait image left with the quote right
featured dark layout with large portrait and an optional per-item CTA link
per-item name, role, company, avatar, portrait media, and link

variants.description: Single large centered quote from the first item on a cream band. Default.
Long-form quote; uses long_quote, falling back to the first item's quote.
Centered text-only quote slider: attribution above, large bold quote, progress dots. Paged through items.
3-column bordered cards with stars, quote, avatar, and attribution. Uses the eyebrow/headline/intro header.
Portrait (items[].media) left, quote right, paged per item with dots + round arrows. Uses the header.
Dark (near-black) band with a square portrait left and white quote right, plus an optional per-item link (link/link_label).

breakpoints.mobile: Cards stack; slider/featured show portrait above the quote.
breakpoints.desktop: 3-column cards; slider/featured split portrait and quote.

ai.prompt_summary: Testimonials: customer quotes. Settings: variant (quote-xl|quote-flow|slider-text|cards|slider|featured, matching Figma), eyebrow, headline, intro (used by cards/slider header), long_quote (quote-flow only). Quotes in items[] (min 1): { quote, name, role, company, avatar (small round image), media (portrait for slider/featured), link + link_label (optional CTA for the featured variant) }. All quotes render in the sans face with an accent-coloured quote mark.
ai.content_guidelines: Quotes in first person, 1-3 sentences (long_quote may run 1-2 paragraphs). Always attribute with name + role/company. 3 items for cards; several for slider-text/slider. Add a per-item link only on the featured variant.

field_hints.long_quote: Only read by quote-flow; falls back to the first item's quote when empty.
field_hints.items.media: Larger portrait used by the slider and featured variants; avatar stays the small round image.
field_hints.items.quote: No surrounding quotation marks — the layout adds them.
field_hints.items.link: Only rendered by the featured variant (items[0]); shows as 'Zur Case Study →' using link_label.
